description: Signing of the Research Outsourcing Contract between the Korea Institute of Ceramic Engineering and Technology and the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A research concept proposal titled 'Development of Processing Technology for Quarts (Thirivana) and Silica Sand in Coastal Regions of Sri Lanka' submitted by a research team of the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka, was selected by the Korea Invention Promotion Association as an Intellectual Property (IP) Partnership Project in the year 2025. The said Project is scheduled to be implemented in two phases. The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2026-04-06, granted approval to sign the Memorandum of Understanding for its first phase, between the Korea Invention Promotion Association of the Republic of Korea and the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka. A Contract Agreement is to be entered into between the Korea Institute of Ceramic Engineering and Technology and the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka for the implementation of the second phase of the said project. The said Agreement will provide the legal basis for the Industrial Technology Institute of Sri Lanka to procure the necessary funds, materials, research equipment and technical support for the relevant research activities from the Republic of Korea with the assistance of the Korean Institute of Ceramic Engineering and Technology. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to sign the Research Outsourcing Contract between the Korea Institute of Ceramic Engineering and Technology and the Industrial Technology Institute of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka for the second phase of the project 'Development of Processing Technology for Quarts and Silica Sand in Coastal Regions of Sri Lanka', was approved by the Cabinet.
